candidate.answerReason: The new base is 11/10 of the original, so the new altitude is 10/11 of the original. The decrease is 1/11, or 9 1/11%, agreeing with E.

methods.label: Keep the product unchanged
methods.explanation:
A rectangle's area is base times altitude. Since the area stays fixed, multiplying its positive base by a factor requires dividing the altitude by that factor.

The new base is \(110\%=\frac{11}{10}\) of the original, so the new altitude is \(\frac{10}{11}\) of the original. The fraction lost is therefore
\[
1-\frac{10}{11}=\frac1{11}.
\]
As a percentage of the original altitude, this is
\[
\frac1{11}\cdot100\%=\frac{100}{11}\%=9\frac1{11}\%.
\]
The answer is \(\boxed{\text{E}}\).
